description: This file defines a class DallE3ImageGenerationConfig for configuring and processing responses for OpenAI's DALL-E 3 image generation API. It includes methods for handling parameters, mapping supported parameters, and transforming API responses into internal data structures, along with internal logging.

classes.name: DallE3ImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for DALL-E 3 image generation, extending BaseImageGenerationConfig with methods to support specific parameters and response transformation.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of openai image generation parameters supported by DALL-E 3.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps provided non-default parameters to the optional parameters, validating support and optionally dropping unsupported params.
